FindPal searches your phone on your phone. Nothing you type or index leaves the device. The only network request downloads public exchange rates (European Central Bank, via frankfurter.app) when you convert a currency, and you can turn that off. FindPal Pro subscriptions are handled entirely by Google Play: FindPal never sees your payment details.
FindPal reads your contacts to find them by name or number. They are kept on this phone and never uploaded.
FindPal reads file names and folders to build a search index on this phone. File contents are not read and nothing is uploaded.

To find documents, downloads and other non-media files anywhere on your phone, Android needs you to allow “All files access” for FindPal on the next screen. FindPal only reads names and folders to build a search index that never leaves this phone.
